title: Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas
body:
●Jis nay ik baar tumhain dil say pukara Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Us pay mushkil nahi aati hai dubara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Sirf Hasnain nahi bag-e-fidak kay waris
Us mai haq rakha hai Zehra nay tumhara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Mehar Zehra mai tha us wastay mola ki qasam
Tunay pani ko tamacha nahi mara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Apni nazron ki utari hai nazar khud mai nay
Karke jee bhar kay teray dar ka nazara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Adha lashkar teri nazron say kata darya par
Adha lashkar teray rahwar nay mara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Jo bina hathon kay karte hain hukumat sab per
Ya Ali bus wo khuda hai ya tumhara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Hai yaqeen bara imamon kay liye dunya mai
Zehra kehti tou khuda bhejta bara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Tera Asghar jo jawan hota tou hota Bibi
Puray ka pura Ali saray ka sara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Jo manga sakti hai ik lamhe mai jannat se libas
Hath se us ne siya kurta tumhara Abbas
<<MINI>>
● Jis Nay Ek Baar Tumhai Dil Say Pukara Abbas (ع) ●
<<DIVIDER>>
●Har koi hoga wafadar jahan mai Sajjad
Gar samajh agaya dunya ko hamara Abbas
author: Mir Hassan Mir
